//: .expo/types is deliberately NOT included, and app.json sets
expo-router's typed-route declarations are written to
.expo/types/router.d.ts by the DEV SERVER only — `expo export` does not
produce them — and .expo/ is gitignored. That made this a check that
behaved differently in three places: a developer who had run `expo start`
typechecked against a generated file, a developer who had not typechecked
without it, and CI never had it at all. Worse, the file goes stale: on
2026-08-15 the committed routes failed typecheck locally against a
months-old router.d.ts that had somehow captured paths from apps/web,
while CI would have passed the same commit.
A gate that is stricter on one machine than in CI is not a gate. Routes
are plain strings until typed routes can be generated as part of the
build; revisit if Expo ships a standalone type-generation command.
